output.summary: The LT Verdict analysis is VALID with COMPLETE coverage, but the overall verdict is NO_POLICY because no business or resource policy thresholds are configured — this is not a PASS. The run had 7,200 JMeter samples with error_count 0 and measured throughput of 20 rps, exactly matching the constant target (20 requests/s) in both windows. Latency was mostly flat: reference p50 188 ms / p95 238 ms / p99 240 ms / max 240 ms; evaluation p50 199 ms / p95 236 ms / p99 239 ms / max 240 ms. Resource-00 (ratio utilization) rose from reference mean 0.480 to evaluation mean 0.529 while the load stayed constant. One correlation candidate (pair-00) was selected: a negative association between resource-00 and response_time_p95_ms with best lag +1000 ms (best_lag_rho -0.472; raw/partial rho -0.381), but the target control was dropped as CONSTANT_CONTROL, uncertainty is NOT_ESTIMATED, status is CANDIDATE, clock_alignment is not_verified_by_core, and anomalies_tested = 0. No causal or stability claims are supported by the referenced evidence.

hypotheses.observation: In the evaluation window, the selected correlation pair reports raw_rho = partial_rho = -0.3807 between resource-00 and response_time_p95_ms, with best_lag_rho -0.4720 at best_lag_ms +1000; p95 latency is nearly flat (236-238 ms in both windows) while resource-00 spans roughly 0.30-0.70.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: The negative sign could reflect a genuine inverse coupling, but because the resource series varies widely while p95 latency is nearly constant, it may instead be driven by unrelated short-term fluctuations or a spurious alignment; it should not be read as 'higher utilization reduces latency'.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Plot per-cell resource-00 against p95 latency, test correlation stability across sub-windows, and recompute on de-meaned or detrended series to see whether the negative sign persists.

hypotheses.observation: The correlation pipeline selected best_lag_ms = 1000, while resource-binding reports clock_alignment = 'not_verified_by_core'.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: The +1000 ms lag may suggest resource-00 leads latency by about one second, but with the clock relationship unverified the ordering is not established and cannot support a temporal causal claim; the improvement over lag 0 (rho -0.4656 vs -0.4720 at +1000 ms) is small.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Verify clock alignment between load generation and resource telemetry first, then re-run the correlation analysis after clock verification before interpreting any lag.

hypotheses.observation: The only requested control (target, requests/s) was dropped with reason CONSTANT_CONTROL (iqr = mad = sample_standard_deviation = 0 in both windows), so controls_used = [] and partial_rho equals raw_rho (-0.3807).
hypotheses.possible_explanation: Because no control was applied, the correlation is unadjusted and may be confounded by unmeasured variables; with constant 20 rps there is no load variation to distinguish load-driven effects from other drivers.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Re-run the load test with a time-varying request profile (ramp or step) so the target series is not constant, enabling controls_used and a load-adjusted partial correlation.

hypotheses.observation: resource-00 mean rose from 0.4803 (reference) to 0.5290 (evaluation) under identical constant 20 rps target, with no missing cells and error_count 0 in both window metric summaries; both window policy summaries are NO_POLICY.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: The increased utilization could come from background activity, drift, or internal state changes, but with no policy thresholds the change has no defined pass/fail meaning.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Define a resource utilization SLO with an explicit threshold and monitor subsequent windows for excursions; establish a repeated-run baseline before attributing the rise to any cause.

hypotheses.observation: p50 latency increased from 188 ms (reference) to 199 ms (evaluation) while p95 (238 to 236), p99 (240 to 239) and max (240 to 240) stayed essentially flat and error_count remained 0.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: A small shift in the mid-latency distribution could reflect modest service behavior or scheduling changes, but the referenced summaries alone do not identify a cause.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Inspect the full per-sample latency histogram and the per-cell p50 series across both windows to confirm and locate the distributional shift.

hypotheses.observation: The diagnostic summary reports anomalies_tested = 0 and episodes_reported = 0, with status COMPLETE and uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: No anomaly episodes were reported because none were tested for; this does not establish that the system is stable, has spare capacity, or is problem-free.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Enable an explicit anomaly-detection policy/algorithm with defined thresholds and re-evaluate both windows so anomalies are actually tested.

recommendations.action: Configure explicit business and resource policy thresholds (latency, throughput, resource-00 utilization) so future runs produce PASS/FAIL instead of NO_POLICY.
recommendations.rationale: policy_verdict is NO_POLICY and both window policy summaries are NO_POLICY; a missing policy is not a pass and provides no boundary for interpreting latency, throughput, or utilization.

recommendations.action: Verify that clocks and epoch timestamps of the load generator and resource telemetry are aligned before any lag-based inference.
recommendations.rationale: resource-binding reports clock_alignment = 'not_verified_by_core'; an unverified clock relationship cannot support the +1000 ms best lag or a temporal causal hypothesis.

recommendations.action: Quantify uncertainty for the pair-00 correlation (currently NOT_ESTIMATED) by computing confidence intervals and validating with more bootstrap replicates and additional block lengths.
recommendations.rationale: The pair status is CANDIDATE with uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED even though the headline selection reported holm-adjusted p = 0.001; uncertainty and causation are not established.

recommendations.action: Repeat the load test with a time-varying request rate so the target series is not constant, allowing the requested control to be used and a load-adjusted partial correlation to be estimated.
recommendations.rationale: The target series was constant (iqr/mad/sd = 0) and dropped as CONSTANT_CONTROL, so controls_used = [] and partial_rho equals raw_rho (-0.3807).

recommendations.action: Configure anomaly/episode detection with explicit thresholds so future evaluations test anomalies rather than reporting anomalies_tested = 0.
recommendations.rationale: anomalies_tested = 0 and episodes_reported = 0 cannot demonstrate stability or absence of a problem.

recommendations.action: Track p50 latency and resource-00 utilization over time, then re-run after thresholds are defined to see whether the p50 shift (188 to 199 ms) and utilization rise (mean 0.480 to 0.529) persist.
recommendations.rationale: Both metrics changed across windows while error_count stayed 0 and target load was constant; no policy currently exists to classify the change as acceptable or not.

caveats: The overall verdict is NO_POLICY for the analysis and for each window (business and resource); this is not a PASS, and missing policy must not be treated as approval.
clock_alignment = 'not_verified_by_core' means the +1000 ms best lag and any lead/lag or temporal causal interpretation are unverified.
Pair-00 status is CANDIDATE with uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED; the selected holm_adjusted_p_value = 0.001 comes from a bootstrap selection procedure and does not prove causation.
The target control was constant and dropped as CONSTANT_CONTROL; partial_rho equals raw_rho (-0.3807) with no controls used, and sensitivity_without_achieved_rps is null.
anomalies_tested = 0 and episodes_reported = 0; absence of reported episodes does not prove stability, spare capacity, low load, or absence of a problem.
Coverage is COMPLETE with no dropped/missing cells and error_count 0 in all summaries; these are data-quality facts only, not evidence of good performance or headroom.
resource-00 is a ratio whose observed values (about 0.30-0.70 in these windows) have no intrinsic pass/fail meaning without a configured policy threshold.
The measured throughput exactly matched the constant 20 rps target; conclusions about behavior under higher or varying load cannot be drawn from this run.
